cost_probe.claim: Same successful strict workload with independent exact-area proof, boundary materialization, exact-expression serialization, checksum and drop in timing. All outputs and paired checksums agree. Three samples per case on a shared unpinned host with allocator instrumentation; noisy latency is mixed. Warm egg median is about 15.4% higher, FIFO-miss squircle about 11.1% higher. Arrow adds one allocation and 672 requested bytes per operation; star removes one allocation/384 bytes, sector one/192, heart five/544. Other measured allocation counts match. Ring FIFO misses do not imply globally cold scalar caches.

Actual WASM/Node command has wall containment without address-space cap because of V8/WASM reservations. Allocation probe covers the Rust global allocator, not all native allocations or RSS.
